title: 21-case operator array-lift and broadcast sweep over 12 operators, reported twice
status_plain: A 21-case sweep covered the five arithmetic operators, concatenation and all six comparisons over array/scalar, scalar/array, same-shape, row-vs-column outer product, non-broadcastable #N/A padding, #DIV/0! and per-cell plus scalar error propagation, against live Excel 16.0 build 20026. The source reports the outcome qualitatively - "matched Excel on every cell" - and gives the denominator (21) but no explicit 21/21 string, so this record publishes total=21 with passed=null. BUG-FUNC-002 reports the SAME 21-case sweep on the same build and the same date from the broadcast side; the two streams are one measurement reported twice and must not be counted as two.
